profile.subtitleJa: ヘツロンとマキルの娘の子
profile.summaryJa: ヘツロンは六十歳のとき、ギレアドの父マキルの娘を妻とし、彼女がセグブを産んだと記されています。

facts.textJa: セグブの子ヤイルが、ギレアデの地に二十三の町を持ったと続けて記されます。

wikipedia.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, L–Z

primaryWitnesses.text: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
